code = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row))
    seeds = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 4]
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v == 2:
                out[r][c] = 2
            elif v == 4:
                nr = min(r + 1, h - 1)
                out[nr][c] = 4
                if nr == divider - 1:
                    for k in range(1, nr + 1):
                        if c - k >= 0:
                            out[nr - k][c - k] = 4
                        if c + k < w:
                            out[nr - k][c + k] = 4
    return out
'''
